verification: Actual source-only CLI before/after on immutable retained1730, maker18, sprites50 and checker38 memberships, preserving duplicates, errors and panics. YAML/model diagnostics remain separate. Compact fresh controls use parent existing reference runner only. Required gates once stable. invariant: An actual stripe with no atoms receives one base-configuration space atom after recursive styles restore. Its measurement and emission use the same atom including normal space advance, font height/minimum atom height and baseline. A null or absent Display creates no stripe and must not receive synthetic padding.
causal_divergence: The previous consumed-command projection supplies a space only if it observed a sprite barrier. Ordinary blank lines and empty style spans remain zero segments: shared width is zero, emission writes empty text, and height takes a different fallback. Java getWithNewlines(null) is NULL, but getWithNewlines("") creates one empty line; StripeSimple.getAtoms treats all zero-atom actual stripes alike. Rust lexical segment parsing is also used outside actual text lines, so absence must not be represented by globally padding every lexical parse.
planned_change: Add a private actual-line segment projection in text_render, inserting a default-style space when lexical parsing returns no atoms. Route shared measurement, counts, height/ascent and emission through this projection. Keep lexical parse_segments("") empty and caller guards for absent labels unchanged; audit retained CLI losses for consumers conflating absent display with a present line and hand off any family-specific omission rather than modifying model/parser/sequence. Empty styled content gets base style, not leaked nested style. Preserve public APIs.
